purpose: Progressive-enhancement contract for the Blade public landing, dedicated pricing page, and policies.
entry: resources/js/landing.js is the Vite JavaScript entry; resources/css/landing.css is separate. Public pages do not import the React app entry.

navigation.closeOn: same-page anchor, Escape, outside click; restore focus on Escape only

motion.zones: [data-motion-zone] adds .is-in-view while intersecting; CSS loops run only for running, visible zones
motion.loopControl: automatic only: page-hidden and offscreen zones pause; reduced-motion overrides; there is no manual motion preference or storage key
motion.reveal: [data-reveal] values rise, line, wipe, stagger; WAAPI once on first intersection; default HTML/CSS remains visible
motion.pointer: optional bounded tilt on [data-orbit-stage]; disabled for coarse pointers and reduced motion

tabs.keyboard: Arrow keys, Home, End; server content stays visible without JavaScript

faq.behavior: native without JavaScript; enhancement never steals focus or scroll

pricing.carousel: data-pricing-carousel with cyclic previous/next DOM rotation; 3 desktop, 2 tablet, 1 mobile

localization.seo: language-specific canonical, hreflang, Content-Language, sitemap entries

theme.darkLogoRule: Anthropic/Z.ai/Kimi white; ChatGPT/DeepSeek/Gemini unchanged; no tiles

pricingManagement.duration: duration_package_prices with IDR and independent USD
pricingManagement.usage: usage_rates for API input/output and image/video unit meters
pricingManagement.admin: /admin/settings persists changes through protected APIs without asset rebuild

modelCatalog.source: sanitized live AI proxy metadata with marketing fallback plus active usage_rates
modelCatalog.filters: search, input modality, capability, billing, context, provider
modelCatalog.layout: 240px sticky sidebar plus compact six-column comparison table
modelCatalog.seo: SSR ItemList and crawlable model rows

policy: Shared public layout; landing/pricing selectors are null-safe and legal text remains readable without animation.
cleanup: pagehide cancels transient work and listeners when appropriate; pageshow restores bfcache state.
